purpose: Narrow the procedural center part and replace index-randomized curtain ends with spatially coherent macro length groups.

iterationResults.finding: A new 60-card part layer closed some frontal scalp but rendered as ladder-like transverse sheets in the top view and produced stray top spikes.
Root-space rear length clustering at 0.69-0.99 created visible macro variation but opened an unnatural right postauricular gap.
Bounding the rear spatial scale to 0.80-0.99 retained layered end variation without the large ear gap. The remaining rear flow is still too straight and the center part remains wide.

gains: Hairline keeps the r399 soft density transition.
Rear ends have bounded spatial length groups instead of a perfectly even curtain.
failures: Top surface still reads as overlapping flat sheets.
Rear cards need curved macro locks and depth layers.
Browser alpha sorting, memory and FPS remain unverified.

decision: Promote r402 only as the latest runtime technical prototype. Keep r383 as offline authoring truth and website v83 unchanged.
nextRequiredWork: Author a narrow offset part and interleaved top macro locks in the guide source, then add curved rear inner/outer groups before browser gates.
